votes.motion: Commissioner Shelton moved to ADJOURN. Commissioner Anderson seconded the motion

Commissioner Shelton moved to forward a recommendation of APPROVAL to the City Council for Project ZTA-23-002, based on the findings listed in the Staff Memo and attachments dated July 11, 2024, with the addition of the following recommendation: 1. That the language for flagpoles references a minimum three-foot setback. Commissioner Anderson seconded the motion. Vote on Motion: Commissioner Anderson-Yes; Commissioner Poulson-Yes; Commissioner Shelton-Yes, Chair Mills-Yes
Commissioner Anderson moved to ADJOURN. Commissioner Shelton seconded the motion
